title: Jets won’t face Fernando Mendoza when they play the Raiders in Week 8 action

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets won’t face Fernando Mendoza when they play the Raiders in Week 8 action
sources.description: Despite some rumblings that the Las Vegas Raiders were on the verge of giving top overall pick Fernando Mendoza his first career start in the team’s Week 8 games against the New York Jets, the team has decided to stick with veteran Kirk Cousins at quarterback.
